notes.title: Update - New Features
notes.content:
Hey there,
the next batch of User wishes has been implemented: 
[list]
    [*]Pitch Control
    [*]Color Control
[/list]

You can now adjust the Range of the Theremin. Not only does it behave more like a real one, you may also choose a smaller range for more precision. This was done with the help of professional Theremin musician Hermigervill from Iceland. 

See here his first try and tuning suggestions(-24 / 24): 
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iGnIt4p2v3k]Video[/url]

Also you can now choose the color of the Theremin with three simple RGB knobs.

Have fun!

Make awesome music ;)

hOSHI*

notes.title: New Features: Metronome and Reverb
notes.content:
Hello again,
[b]Vremin[/b] now features a [b]Metronome[/b] with variable BPM and a more fitting [b]Reverb[/b] for the concert hall in which we play the Theremin.

For those of us who need a cleaner signal: You can simply disable the reverb with the push of a button. Oh, how i wish this was possible in real life as well ...

So: Have fun and show us your Songs ;)

Greetings

hOSHI*

notes.title: First User Feedback implemented
notes.content:
Hey there,
thanks to the awesome community my ToDo-List got much longer than it was before. Luckily, I was able to implement the first item from this list today:

The Theremin is now usable for both left- and righthanded people. You can simply [b]turn the instrument[/b] (automatically) with the push of a button.

Also i have adjusted the [b]volume control[/b] so you can now stop the tone by nearing to the volume antenna. This is how the original instrument worked and allows playing melodies and single tones.

I hope you enjoy playing [b]VRemin[/b] even more now.

Greetings

hOSHI*

notes.title: VRemin (A Virtual Theremin) is now in Early Access
notes.content:
Hey there,
happy you are interested in this strange instrument as well as myself. I gotta admit: I created this app because i wanted to try out and make my own Theremin. Maybe some of you will like to use it like me. 

You could easily use this app to create music. You could also find other virtual instruments and start the first band made entirely of virtual instruments.

Please feel free to visit the discussions and share your wishes and ideas. I am looking forward to see what we will achieve together.

Greetings from Berlin

hOSHI*
